name: Binyuu Hunter
summary:
Binyuu Hunter is a shooter in which the player controls the young heroine, her back always turned to the player, moving her horizontally, shooting enemies with the left mouse button and reloading with the right. Double-tapping left and right arrow keys results in the heroine diving and jumping to the side. There is a variety of enemies to deal with, from stationary regular soldiers to snipers, grenade-tossing enemies, enemies with protective shields, bosses with special techniques, etc. Each stage typically consists of many enemy waves coming in different patterns and with increasing difficulty.

The story of the game is told through anime-style cut scenes. Once a shooting stage is over, the player is taken to a separate screen that allows him to choose a picture of a pretty girl, usually absolutely unrelated to the plot. Pictures of those girls appear on the screen, with less and less clothes, and the player can scroll, aim with the mouse, and capture a "photo" of the girl, which will then be saved in the gallery (accessible from the main menu).
